caption: The drawing depicts three objects on a plain, light beige background: a cylindrical black padlock, a detached U-shaped shackle, and a key. The padlock is shown lying on its side with a rectangular keyhole visible. The U-shaped shackle, rendered in a dark metallic gray, is positioned to the right of the padlock, with both of its ends featuring a series of notches or grooves. The key, appearing in a matching dark gray color, is situated in the lower left part of the drawing and displays a circular bow with similarly notched cuts along its shaft, matching the design of the shackle ends. The objects are spaced apart on the otherwise empty background, and there is minimal shading. The artist's name, "LeRoy Griffith," appears in small text near the lower right of the image.
title: Padlock
